chunks: And ʿUmar ibn Yazīd narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
Beware of laziness and restlessness, for they are the key to every evil. Indeed, whoever is lazy will not fulfill any right, and whoever is restless will not remain patient upon a right.

key_terms.الضَّجَرَ: restlessness or impatience; a state that prevents endurance and steadiness
key_terms.الْكَسَلَ: laziness; a state that causes neglect of duties and rights
key_terms.حَقًّا: a right or due; an obligation owed and to be fulfilled
key_terms.حَقٍّ: truth or right; that which must be upheld
key_terms.مِفْتَاحُ: key; that which opens the door to something else

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about laziness and restlessness?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against laziness and restlessness as two destructive traits that open the way to all kinds of evil. It teaches that laziness causes a person to neglect obligations, while restlessness prevents steadfastness in carrying out what is right.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Beware of laziness and restlessness, for they are the keys to every evil. Indeed, whoever is lazy will not fulfill a right, and whoever is restless will not endure upon the truth."
